Author: Martz
Name: Qiqirn Companion
Description: Browse open FC craft projects and claim tasks directly from inside the game. Trading queries, item search, and craft-from-inventory with live Marketboard prices.
Punchline: In-game FC project tracker, trading scanner, and craft helper.
Changelog: Item view overhaul: the item window now shows item level, category, rarity, and HQ-capable tags with quick links (Garland, Gamer Escape, Universalis); a make-vs-buy Verdict card with the best play, margin, gil/day, ROI, and risk; and a priced recipe table with per-ingredient source tags (Vendor/Gather/Craft/MB) and a material total. Items with no data now show a clear message instead of a blank panel.
